scenes.caption: Hold baby close, facing your breast
scenes.narration_line: Keep your baby close to your breast, facing it.

scenes.caption: Wait for a wide-open mouth
scenes.narration_line: Wait until your baby’s mouth is wide open.

scenes.caption: Bring baby on, chin first
scenes.narration_line: Move your baby on quickly, aiming chin below the nipple.

scenes.caption: Check chin touches, lip turned out
scenes.narration_line: Look for chin touching the breast and lower lip turned out.
safety_points: If suckling is painful, your baby may not be well attached.
